cards.text: Everyone in the group must say one word each to build a sentence. You start.
Point to someone in the group — they must down their drink or do ten jumping jacks.
Everyone must speak in an accent for the next three rounds. You pick the accent.
Start a conga line. It only ends when you decide it ends.
Assign each person in the group a spirit animal. Defend your choices.
Everyone must text someone outside this group saying 'you crossed my mind tonight.'
Introduce everyone in the group to an imaginary new person as if you're their biggest fan.
The group must agree on one group photo pose. You have thirty seconds to negotiate.
Name a song — everyone must do a specific move whenever the beat drops for the rest of the night.
Set a group challenge: everyone must avoid saying a word you choose for the rest of the night.
The group must vote on who is most likely to be famous one day. Majority rules.
Do a thirty-second toast about tonight that ends with everyone drinking.
Everyone names the worst decision they made this week. Group votes on the winner.
Assign a one-word nickname to every person in the group right now. It sticks for the night.
The group must agree on the highlight of tonight so far. Debate until consensus.
Everyone must share the most unhinged plan they've made and never followed through on.
The group must complete this sentence out loud, one word each, going around the circle three times.
Pick someone to be the DJ for the next ten minutes. Everyone else must dance to their selections.
The group must create a handshake between two people in under two minutes. Perform it.
Everyone simultaneously shows the last meme they saved. The group votes on the best one.
The group must agree on the one food that best describes this energy tonight.
Everyone tells the group one thing they want to happen before the night ends.
The group has ninety seconds to choreograph a group bow. Perform it at the end of the next round.
Go around the circle — each person adds one rule to tonight. All rules are now in effect.
The group must agree on the one song that defines this group. Play thirty seconds of it.
Everyone must compliment the person to their right using only song titles.
The group takes one unanimous decision about what happens next tonight.
Group vote: who here would survive longest in a survival situation? Defend your answer.
The whole group must go silent for ten seconds. You time it. Go.
